cohort: Infants born at 22-25 weeks of gestation
finding: The study found that the rate of active treatment for infants born at 23 weeks of gestation increased in California between 2011 and 2018, but not at 22 weeks, and several maternal and infant factors were associated with the likelihood of active treatment.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of active treatment in infants born at 22-25 weeks of gestation.
